Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton

Minneapolis, MN · North Loop · Social

No-dropFamilyBeginner friendly

Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton is a social group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls second Thursday of the month at 6:00 pm from Fulton Beer Taproom. Pace: 8–10 mph, party pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @joyfulridersclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Joyful Riders Club Monthly Ride at Fulton group ride

A slow, family-friendly party ride that starts and ends at the Fulton taproom in the North Loop. About an hour and a half of riding with music. The club is based in Minneapolis and Saint Paul and also runs summer DJ rides.
